result.note: Tests the India-Italy Special Strategic Partnership and trade target, the IMEC push, and the agreements signed in Rome in May 2026.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about India-Italy relations as of May 2026:
items: In May 2026, the two countries elevated their relations to a Special Strategic Partnership at a meeting in Rome.
They set a bilateral trade target of EUR 20 billion by 2029.
Italy acts primarily as a supplier of steel and chemicals to India.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 3 is wrong. Italy is primarily a machinery supplier to India, with machinery making up nearly 40% of its exports, while steel, electronics and chemicals are Indian exports to Italy. Bilateral trade stood at EUR 14.2 billion in 2024, so the 2029 target needs roughly 40% growth.
questions.source: Prime Minister Modi and Italian Prime Minister Meloni elevated India-Italy relations to a Special Strategic Partnership in Rome on Tuesday, setting a EUR 20 billion bilateral trade target by 2029 and signing agreements on defence, critical minerals, and innovation.

questions.prompt: In May 2026, India and Italy called for the first ministerial meeting of which connectivity initiative to take concrete steps in 2026?
questions.explain: Modi and Meloni reaffirmed their commitment to IMEC and called for its first Ministerial meeting in 2026. They also pushed for early implementation of the India-EU FTA, whose negotiations concluded in 2026.
questions.source: Both leaders reaffirmed their commitment to the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) and called for the first IMEC Ministerial meeting to take concrete steps in 2026.

questions.prompt: Consider the following pairs relating to outcomes of the India-Italy summit in Rome in May 2026:
items: Joint Declaration of Intent — Nurse mobility from India to Italy
Defence industrial roadmap — Co-production of helicopters, naval platforms and electronic warfare systems
INNOVIT India — Innovation hub covering sectors from semiconductors to quantum computing
questions.ask: How many of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
questions.explain: All three pairs match the story. The two sides also signed MoUs on critical minerals and agriculture.
questions.source: a defence industrial roadmap covering co-production of helicopters, naval platforms, and electronic warfare systems, and a Joint Declaration of Intent on nurse mobility from India to Italy
